reason: Forward who joined New York City FC (MLS) from FC Basel 1893 as a Designated Player on 29 June 2026, with official club, league and press sources. Ivory Coast international; several sources agree on the transfer. Today's Atlanta match report could not be verified and is left out.

sources.title: New York City FC Acquires Forward Bénie Traoré from FC Basel 1893 as a Designated Player
New York City FC acquire forward Bénie Traoré from Basel
Ivorian winger Bénie Traoré leaves Basel to join New York City FC

birthPlace.note: NYCFC player profile lists Bouaké, Côte d'Ivoire.

nationality.note: Described as an Ivorian, Ivory Coast international. Caps figures differ between sources (NYCFC and MLS say seven senior appearances or caps; Wikipedia differs), so no cap count is used.

gapNote: Could not verify the claimed 28 Oct 2026 NYCFC 2-1 win over Atlanta United, the stoppage-time winner, the Embolo equaliser, or any AP report: the searches returned only a pre-match listing and older Atlanta results. Left out. NYCFC appearance and goal counts could not be verified as of today (amNY, 5 Aug 2026, said no NYCFC goal yet; figures are dated), so none are stated. The fee is not disclosed by the clubs (MLS, AfricaSoccer); a 20 Minutes/Transfermarkt estimate of EUR 8.75m is unofficial and not used. Sources disagree on Basel tenure (one season vs two) and on Ivory Coast caps; the page avoids both numbers. Top results do not give the NYCFC shirt number or the verified birth details in one place; this page can.
